name: vLLM Ascend A3 (Ascend 910C Dev Container)
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y ccache dos2unix clang-15 && update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/clang clang /usr/bin/clang-15 20 && update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/clang++ clang++ /usr/bin/clang++-15 20 && ccache --set-config=max_size=10G && find /workspace/vllm-ascend -name '*.sh' -exec dos2unix {} \; && echo 'source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh' >> /root/.bashrc && echo 'source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh' >> /root/.bashrc && echo 'export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/usr/local/lib' >> /root/.bashrc && pip3 install --extra-index-url https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu -r requirements-dev.txt && pip3 install --extra-index-url https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu -e . && pip3 uninstall -y triton triton-ascend && pip3 install triton-ascend==3.2.2 --extra-index-url https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi && pip3 install coverage
